thread:
samir: Kickoff: starting canary for the inference-routing feature flag. Rolling to 10% now. Plan: 10m hold -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% with 10m holds unless errors spike. Pin model v1.9 for the 10% cohort. Will post release notes link. @olivia you're on perf watch.

deploy-bot: Canary started: feature_flag=inference-routing, percent=10, release_id=rel_2026_03_20_001

alex: seeing slight 0.4% 5xx uptick in eu-west on first 2m. not huge but worth watching. Suggest hold on eu-west ramp.

maya: Can we pin traffic for the 10% cohort to model v1.9 (fallback) and set 1% of requests to v1.8 for smoke? command: `/ff pin inference-routing --cohort=10% --model=v1.9`

samir: Yes pin in place. Running pin now. If error_rate > 1.5% for 5m -> rollback to v1.9 across whole cohort. If latency p95 increases >200ms -> pause.

deploy-bot: Action: pin applied -> cohort=10% pinned to v1.9. Rollout timers started.

olivia: Monitoring dashboards up: https://internal.redwood/dash/rel_2026_03_20_001 — will ping on anomalies. If CPU on gpu-pool spikes >85% we'll throttle batch size.

alex: :thumbsup: holding eu-west ramp. Can we move non-eu traffic to 25% as planned?

samir: Agree. Move us-east and us-west to 25% now, keep eu-west at 10% hold. Initiating gradual shift.

deploy-bot: Traffic shift started: us-east/us-west -> 25%. eu-west remains 10%.

maya: Note for release notes: changed routing algorithm to prefer cheaper small-batch kernels; cost-savings estimate ~8% token spend. Add note about KV cache invalidation warning for long sessions.

release-coordinator: I've updated release-notes doc: https://confluence.redwood/release/2026-03-20-inference-routing — added rollback criteria and pinning details.

olivia: Perf stable at 12m; no error spike. Recommend proceed to 50% after 10m more. cc @samir

samir: Proceeding to 50% for non-eu. If any anomaly flag -> roll back automated. Scheduling final ramp 1h window.

deploy-bot: Next step scheduled in 10m: increase to 50% for us-east/us-west.
